PLAN "12-Week Cycle-Sensitive Strength Program for Stage III Endometriosis"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Progressive overload with cycle-aware programming and flare-window accommodation"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Week 1 - Base loading":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          planks 3x30 seconds rpe 4
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Week 1 - Upper/Lower balance":
        warmup:
          jogging_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Week 2 - Volume increase":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Week 2 - Posterior chain focus":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          cable_pullthrough 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Week 3 - Moderate load":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..20 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Week 3 - Mobility and core":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x30 seconds per side
        cooldown:
          thoracic_extension 60 seconds
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Week 4 - Deload week":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretch 90 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Phase 2 - Cycle onset after flare window":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_openers 60 seconds
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Phase 2 - A2 upper pull emphasis":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Phase 2 - Lower body strength":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          glute_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Phase 2 - Tempo work":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x8..12 rpe 6
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 60 seconds
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Phase 2 - Deload + mobility":
        warmup:
          walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretch 90 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Phase 3 - Build intensity":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x5 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 5x5 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Phase 3 - Accessory emphasis":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Phase 3 - Peak intensity (outside flare windows)":
        warmup:
          jogging_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x4..6 rpe 9 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 4x4..6 rpe 9 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x4..6 rpe 9 rest 120 seconds
          leg_extension 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_extension 60 seconds
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Phase 3 - Deload + plan for progression":
        warmup:
          walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretch 90 seconds

NOTES / CONSIDERATIONS
- Flare window adjustments: During any period overlapping 2026-07-10 to 2026-07-13 and 2026-08-04 to 2026-08-07, replace high-impact or high-Valsalva movements (e.g., heavy squats, deadlifts, max-effort sets, any exercise requiring Valsalva) with lighter loads, tempo ranges, or substitute: leg_extension for leg press, banded pulls for some rows, and avoid maximal loads. Keep volume/moderate RPE (6–7) and avoid explosive jumps or hop movements.
- No HIIT or jumping on flow days or flare days: ensure sessions in those windows emphasize control, tempo, and contact-free movements.
- Cycle-based progression: weekly loads should increase gradually when tolerated, with a planned deload week every 4 weeks (weeks 4, 8, 12) to align with menstrual cycle considerations and flare windows.
- Repetitions and sets: all rep schemes follow the DSL: sets first, e.g., 4x6..10 rpe 7, and rest times specified. All exercise names must be canonical as per vocabulary.
- Cardio modalities used only from: running, cycling, swimming, rowing, elliptical, jump_rope, walking, hiking. Warmups/cooldowns use appropriate modality.
- Adjustments: if any exercise cannot be performed due to individual restrictions, substitute with a closely related movement from the allowed vocabulary (e.g., replace deadlift with romanian_deadlift if appropriate, but ensure it remains within policy and client tolerance).
- Data tracking: monitor RPE and symptoms daily; if endometriosis-related pain intensifies, pare back intensity further and replace impacted lifts with accessory work of similar loading.
